candidates.description: This vector represents theological concepts related to the divine, spirituality, and good versus evil.
This feature vector represents religious groups, institutions, and beliefs, with a particular emphasis on Christianity.
This feature activates on terms related to religious devotion, deities, and sacred concepts.
This vector represents cultural traditions, customs, and habitual practices.
This vector represents religious figures, holy entities, and associated ecclesiastical traditions.
This vector represents adverbs of frequency, likelihood, and manner that modify verbs or clauses to express how or when actions occur.
This vector represents artistic or conceptual motifs, themes, and stylistic elements.
This vector activates for words related to clothing, attire, and the act of wearing garments.
These tokens represent verb suffixes and their inflected forms used to create or modify action words.
This vector represents celebratory, religious, or formal public processions and associated festive terminology.
